name: PassMark: CPU Floating Point Maths Test
description: Testing how fast the CPU can perform mathematical floating point operations, using large sets of an equal number of random 32-bit and 64-bit floating point numbers for addition (30% of the time), subtraction (30% of the time), multiplication (30% of the time) and division (10% of the time), with floating point buffers totaling about 240kb per core.

environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
